scope: separate canonical and noncanonical phylogenies; uncertain Nature systems diagnostic only

host_markers.panel: GToTree Bacteria.hmm, 74 Pfam models; author MD5 verified and SHA256 frozen
host_markers.duplicates: mask all copies of a marker in a genome; no highest-score choice
host_markers.length_filter: retain within 20 percent of across-genome marker median; report exclusions
host_markers.BGC_exclusion: conservatively mask markers overlapping mapped publication windows; C-only projected windows flagged
host_markers.genome_admission: at least 80 percent of 74 markers usable as independent single-copy sequences
host_markers.genome_redundancy: one computational representative per exact strand-independent genome-content hash, retaining all BioSample and gene mappings

components.initial_native_scope: source-provenance-supported occurrences or whole-export-exact occurrences in known frozen assemblies
components.C: native DNA/translation checked, source role/context and domain evidence recorded; different annotation variants retained for review
components.B1_B2: standard BLASTP against published M2/Bgel/Cpal/Ptar references; both coverages >=70 percent, E<=1e-5; local C context and domain inventory; multiple copies retained
components.auxiliary: GNAT and ABC require full-length reference homology plus context and family-tree inspection; no universal GNAT/ABC role
components.precursor: DNA and amino-acid sequences/alleles; no forced standalone tree
components.uncertain_Nature: separate diagnostic C/domain/context assessment; no automatic addition to primary canonical tree

phylogeny.site_filter: trimAl -gappyout; retain raw alignment and removed-column statistics
phylogeny.ML: IQ-TREE ModelFinder over LG,WAG,JTT with gamma; marker partitions merged using relaxed clustering
phylogeny.support: 1000 ultrafast bootstrap with BNNI and 1000 SH-aLRT for main component/host trees
phylogeny.marker_trees: individual ML trees and support, informative-site inventory; assess conflicts with concatenation
phylogeny.identical_gene_sequences: keep separate biological copies and carriers; deduplicate only repeated exports of same physical gene
phylogeny.root: unrooted primary estimates; any display root explicit and non-historical; reconciliation roots decided later
phylogeny.sensitivity: targeted untrimmed or site-heterogeneous alternative when alignment loss/composition diagnostics warrant it

interpretation: putative orthology and topology support; neither HGT event support nor p-value for transfer
resource_plan: native extraction/HMM array max8 jobs x2CPU/4GB; marker/tree jobs through Slurm; main host tree jobs up to8CPU/16GB, wall limit8h; measure pilot before broadening
